children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game where children must stay in perfect sync with the head dancer.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the synchronized arm gestures and upper body rhythmic pulses while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Reduce the speed by half and use a chair for balance during footwork.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Significantly slower tempo; focus on small, controlled steps.

social_formats.description: Performed by men in synchronized groups, often at weddings.

signature_moves.description: The dancers perform identical moves in perfect unison at a high speed.
signature_moves.name: Synchronized Group Movement

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Lack of synchronization with the group; falling behind the fast tempo.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by a rapid, driving tempo typical of Azerbaijani national folk music, designed to support synchronized, high-speed male movement.

basic_steps: Execute synchronized footwork in time with the fast national music
Coordinate arm movements with the group to ensure visual unity
teaching.formation: Group synchronization (often linear or circular, though specific geometry is not detailed)
teaching.level_notes: Requires high cardiovascular endurance due to the quick pace.
